_comment: Scraped slug -> AniList media id, for titles AniList's SEARCH cannot reach even
though the entry exists. build-artwork-map.mjs consults this before searching.
This is not about the title scorer - the scorer never runs, because the search
returns zero candidates. AniList tokenises on the spelling it stores, so a
different word split ('Yoroi Shin Den' vs AniList's 'Yoroi-Shinden') or a
different cour word ('Part 2' vs AniList's 'Cour 2') yields nothing at all.
Consequence when a row has no anilistId: no metadata, no TMDB artwork, and - the
reason this file exists - no franchise grouping, because grouping walks AniList
relations. Yoroi Shin Den Samurai Troopers showed Part 2 as a separate, unrelated
entry with Part 1 nowhere in the season picker.
Add an entry only when you have confirmed the id on anilist.co. A wrong id is
worse than none: it attaches another show's synopsis, score and artwork.
The five entries added 2026-09-04 are a different failure from the rest: AniList
search DID answer, with the wrong season. Two slugs of one franchise resolved to
one id, dedupeCatalogShows merged the rows, and the survivor played season 2's
episodes under season 1's identity. anilistSearch now requires the season number
to agree, so these would resolve to nothing without an explicit id.
